article.headline: Holt's 21 lead Sacramento State over Bethesda (California) 78-38
article.description: — Jacob Holt scored 21 points as Sacramento State beat Bethesda (Calif.) 78-38 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Holt's 21 lead Sacramento State over Bethesda (California) 78-38
article.story: SACRAMENTO, Calif. -- — Jacob Holt scored 21 points as Sacramento State beat Bethesda (Calif.) 78-38 on Monday night. Holt added 10 rebounds for the Hornets (4-9). Bowyn Beatty scored 11 points and added nine rebounds. Lachlan Brewer had 11 points and shot 4 for 7, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc. Cameron Durr led the way for the Flames with 15 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
